plan.title: Display config.yaml in VSCode plugin panel
plan.overview: Add a second TreeView "Kanban Config" to the VSCode sidebar that displays config.yaml as a clickable item. The capability follows the existing TreeDataProvider pattern from tasks-view.capability.ts, using a simple single-item tree with click-to-open behavior. File watcher extended to refresh both views when config.yaml changes.

approach.rationale:
This is the first additional TreeView in the extension. VSCode automatically creates collapsible sections when multiple views exist in a viewsContainer. Following existing patterns: - TreeDataProvider pattern: tasks-view.capability.ts:253-276 - FileItem click-to-open: tasks-view.capability.ts:198-214 - Factory with DI: tasks-view.capability.ts:248-250 - ThemeIcon usage: tasks-view.capability.ts:216-227
The config view is simpler than tasks view - no hierarchy needed, just a single item or empty state. We reuse the existing kanban.openFile command for click-to-open.
